fixed.standardization: StandardScaler fitted on training examples only, except RobustScaler median/IQR variant; equal-session scaler weights 1/n_session
fixed.selection: ANOVA F-score top 32 from training targets only
fixed.cnn: N,9,33; left-pad Conv1d9->24 kernel5; left-pad Conv1d24->32 kernel5 dilation2; temporal mean->linear1
fixed.augmentation: Original +2 training copies; one gain uniform[.8,1.2] per physical PPG channel shared across its three derivatives; Gaussian noise SD .05 times training-only per-derivative/channel SD pooled over examples and time; probability .15 drops one physical channel across all orders. No raw PPG. Noise is a derivative-space perturbation, not a claim of an integrable raw signal.
fixed.loso: one LR per excluded training session, independently training-fitted scaler; arithmetic probability mean
fixed.dro: q uniform over training sessions; once/epoch q *= exp(0.05 * detached full-session BCE), renormalize; full-batch weighted session BCE
fixed.coral: full-batch mean BCE + 0.1 * mean squared difference of per-training-session latent covariance from mean covariance; only groups with >=2 examples
fixed.multiscale: per-channel tail lengths4,8,16,32: mean,std,end-minus-start,mean absolute difference
fixed.haar: per-channel nonoverlapping block mean differences at scales1,2,4,8,16 on final32 samples
fixed.morph: per-channel quantiles0,.1,.25,.5,.75,.9,1; mean,std,total variation,difference std,max rise,max fall,extrema positions/32,zero-crossing fraction; 3 pairwise correlations

input.grid: 25Hz source timestamp ZOH, recording-origin integer grid
input.differentiator: exact ablation degree3 least squares previous9 samples; current excluded; evaluated at current grid time
input.warmup: First z/sigmoid tick20, MAD tick40, derivatives tick49, complete ordered input tick81 (3240ms); no padding or imputation.
input.preprocessing: Per channel: previous25 ticks (1 second, current excluded), minimum20, population z-score; zero SD emits zero; scipy expit without rounding; previous25 sigmoid ticks, minimum20 finite values, median/MAD*1.4826; zero scale emits zero. Unavailable values stay NaN. Then previous9 cubic derivatives.

adaptation_details.augmentation: Original +2 training copies; one gain uniform[.8,1.2] per physical PPG channel shared across its three derivatives; Gaussian noise SD .05 times training-only per-derivative/channel SD pooled over examples and time; probability .15 drops one physical channel across all orders. No raw PPG. Noise is a derivative-space perturbation, not a claim of an integrable raw signal.
adaptation_details.normalization: Causal per-channel z-score/sigmoid/MAD before derivatives; all estimator scalers remain training-only.
adaptation_details.nonlinear_lr: Sigmoid/rounding is applied after train-fitted standardization and is not refitted or standardized using test samples.
adaptation_details.dense: 567->64->32->1; Group DRO and covariance alignment operate only on training sessions
adaptation_details.coverage: All 26 estimators applicable without raw PPG; green-only feature variants expanded to all RGB orders to satisfy joint input

continuous: Fixed threshold .5, rising edges, 1500ms refractory, decision onset+680..1280ms matching; 40ms anchors; no calibration
ranking: Descending minimum then mean then maximum fold AUC
pooled: Concatenate held-out appearances; repeated recordings/events counted repeatedly
preprocessing_exceptions: Undefined zero-variance z-score emits zero, analogous to zero MAD; frozen before scoring.
Retained LR rounding variants round only train-standardized summary features; the preprocessing sigmoid is never rounded.
